about.en: MAP Protocol is omnichain infrastructure for cross-chain swaps between Bitcoin, stablecoins and tokenized assets, using light-client verification and MPC-based threshold signatures to connect the Bitcoin mainnet with chains such as Ethereum, BNB Chain, Tron and Solana. MAPO is the native coin of its MAPO Relay Chain and also exists as an ERC-20/BEP-20 token at 0x7046933234A82AF77F14625e8d0fA9Bcc5044a7E.
